_comment: Creature type per enemy, for the ones generate-foi-bestiary.ts's keyword heuristic can't place —
mostly named individuals, where the name says nothing about what they are.
Keys are canonical names AFTER normalisation, so use straight apostrophes. Set a name to "" to
say 'deliberately blank' and stop it appearing in the generator's to-do list. The generator FAILS
on a key that matches no creature, so a typo here can't quietly do nothing.
Anything still missing is genuinely unidentified — a null type just doesn't appear in the
Bestiary's type facet, whereas a wrong guess pollutes it permanently. Leave it out rather than
guess, and fill it in from the app when it comes up at the table.
